about: The option texts the visuals thread drew chroma-art/game/ink-icons.json's map.option for: the Library's final staged batch of 2026-10-07 (chroma-library/staging/next3/earth.py, earth_science.py, earth_politics.py, earth_stage.py; situations and echoes, which hold the outer-world, identity, child-illness and pregnancy additions and the Packs round 5), moment by moment in the same order, the main (earth) wording. The icon is shared by the tribal and magic wordings of the same option. live_icons.py keeps an icon only where the game's batch has the same text. 2026-10-09: three texts follow the live Library's rewording ('a strike vote at work' 5, 'a march on a working day' 5, 'a landslide on election night' 2); their icons are unchanged. 2026-10-09 (v22.3): the 93 moments of the stage 2 and 3 content (main d795ab5, the game's engine_pin earth.py), added after the rest in game order.
